parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/Wallpaper/Tests/WallpaperTests/QualityMetricsAggregatorTests.swift`. Despite a high structural similarity (Jaccard 0.8636), `tracksInterpolationEnabledPercent` and `countsInterpolationActivations` are distinct test cases exercising different observable behaviours of `QualityMetricsAggregator` — interpolation-enabled percentage tracking versus interpolation activation counting. Merging or extracting them into a shared helper would obscure test intent and couple unrelated assertions, which is the canonical test-fixture restraint pattern.
